settings.hero_desc: A finely detailed scale model of a tug / supply vessel - hull, superstructure, working deck and fittings reproduced faithfully and mounted on a base with a nameplate. A handsome showpiece and gift for vessel owners and operators.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your vessel, livery, name and base plaque
settings.s1_body: We recreate tugs, supply and support vessels as accurate scale models - hull lines, bridge, working deck, winches and fittings all faithful to the real ship. Finished in your livery, named on the hull and mounted on a base with a nameplate, it's a fitting way to mark a delivery, gift an owner or anchor a marine company's office.
settings.case_body: Built to mark the 20th anniversary of Titanium Marine, this model was used to celebrate the milestone and showcase their service in boardroom meetings.
settings.case_quote: An exact likeness of our tug, right down to the deck winch. The owner was thrilled.
settings.prov_p: A vessel represents years of work and serious investment. A faithful model honours that - a showpiece for the office and a meaningful gift for everyone who built or sailed her.
